item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00408","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C17","C06","C01"],"selected_candidate_label":"C17","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C17 is the direct and materially reused institutional template. The child replaces C17's Psychological Strategy Board with the Operations Coordinating Board, preserves its National Security Council reporting relationship, substantially carries forward its core membership, and adapts its mission from coordinating psychological operations to coordinating implementation of national-security policies. The child expressly abolishes the C17 board and transfers its outstanding affairs to the new board, confirming institutional succession. C06 and C01 contain similar board-support, assistance, alternate-member, and wind-up machinery, but neither matches the child's substantive institutional structure as closely as C17.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"there is hereby established an Operations' Coordinating Board ... which shall report to the National Security Council","parent_excerpt":"There is hereby established a Psychological Strategy Board ... The Board will report to the National Security Council","explanation":"The child closely reproduces the establishment-and-reporting framework while substituting the successor board."},{"child_excerpt":"The Board shall have as members ... the Under Secretary of State ... the Deputy Secretary of Defense ... [and] the Director of Central Intelligence","parent_excerpt":"The Board shall be composed of: a. The Undersecretary of State, the Deputy Secretary of Defense, and the Director of Central Intelligence","explanation":"Three core offices are carried forward nearly verbatim, with additional members added for the successor body's broader mission."},{"child_excerpt":"The head of any agency ... to which the President from time to time assigns responsibilities for the implementation of national security policies, shall assign a representative to serve on the Board","parent_excerpt":"An appropriate representative of the head of each such other department or agency of the Government as may, from time to time, be determined by the Board","explanation":"Both provide flexible participation by representatives of other agencies whose responsibilities bear on the board's work."},{"child_excerpt":"advise with the agencies concerned as to ... the coordination of the interdepartmental aspects of the detailed operational plans ... [and] the timely and coordinated execution of such policy and plans","parent_excerpt":"provide for the more effective planning, coordination and conduct, within the framework of approved national policies, of psychological operations","explanation":"The child adapts the predecessor's interagency planning-and-coordination function into a broader operational implementation mandate."},{"child_excerpt":"The Psychological Strategy Board shall be abolished ... and its outstanding affairs shall be wound up by the Operations Coordinating Board","parent_excerpt":"There is hereby established a Psychological Strategy Board","explanation":"The express abolition and transfer of outstanding affairs establishes that the child is reorganizing and succeeding the institution created by C17."}]}
